title: Changes to the table of indicative administrative fines
text:
Supervision release 25 April 2013
-
34/2013
Changes to the table of indicative administrative fines
FIN-FSA has updated its table of indicative administrative fines. The changes are based on the European Market Infrastructure Regulation (648/2012) and legislative amendments relating to it.
For further information, please contact
Jari Synkkänen, Legal Adviser, tel.
+358 (0)10 831 5200
